# dsh-pwsh-guard
**English** | 简体中文

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that enforces one rule: **read files with `read`, search with `grep`,
loca
te files with `glob`** — not with shell text commands.

It registers a `ctx.tools.guard` over `pwsh`, `bash` and `ops_bash`. A call whose command line
perfo

rms file text I/O is rejected before execution, and the rejection reason names the tool to use
inste
ad. Rejection messages follow the host locale (English or Chinese).
## Rules
| id | group | blocks | use instead |

| `search.Select-String`, `search.sls` | textSearch | `Select-String`, `sls` | `grep` |
| `search.fi

ndstr`, `search.grep`, `search.rg` | textSearch | `findstr`, `grep`, `rg` | `grep` |
| `read.Get-Con

tent`, `read.gc`, `read.cat`, `read.type` | textRead | `Get-Content` and its aliases | `read` |
| `r

ead.more`, `read.head`, `read.tail` | textRead | `more`, `head`, `tail` | `read` |
| `bypass.node-ev
al`, `bypass.python-c`, `bypass.php-r`, `bypass.dotnet-io` | runtimeBypass | `node -e`, `python -c`,

`php -r`, `[IO.File]::ReadAllText` that read files | `read`, `grep` |
| `wait.Start-Sleep`, `wait.s
leep` | sleep | `Start-Sleep`, `sleep` | probe the port, read the job again later, `schedule_create`

|
| `pipeline.stderr-merge` | stderrMerge | `2>&1` followed by a pipe | `$LASTEXITCODE`, `2>err.txt

` |
| `job.wait` | jobWait | `job_output` called with `wait: true` | probe the port (`Test-NetConnec
tion`, `curl`), or read the job again later |
Two matching rules keep false positives down:

- Short aliases match in command position only (`^`, `;`, `|`, `&`, `(`, `{`, `$(`), so
`Get-ChildIt

em -Type f`, `git gc` and `git log --grep=x` pass.
- Quoted spans are ignored, so `git commit -m "st

op using Select-String"` passes. Rules that inspect
a script body (`node -e ...`) read the raw strin

using Select-String"` passes. Rules that inspect
a script body (`node -e ...`) read the raw string.

If `install_bundle` reports `failedAt: registry`, the failure came from another dependency of the
pr

ofile; the package link, `package.json` entry and `cordis.yml` row are usually already written.
Chec
k for `node_modules/dsh-pwsh-guard/index.js` and the `id: pwsh-guard` row before retrying.
## Limitations
- Command names inside quotes (`& "Select-String"`, `powershell -Command "Get-Content x"`) are not d

etected.
- `-EncodedCommand` is not decoded.
- `ops_bash --script_path` is checked by path only, not

by script content.
- Directory listing (`Get-ChildItem`, `ls`, `dir`) is out of scope.
- Not a sand

box. For destructive commands and secret access use a dedicated guard such as
`cc-safety-net`; its r

ule schema cannot express "deny every use of this command", which is why
this plugin exists.

## Release

Versions are owned by CI — do not edit `version`. Pushing to `main` runs
`.github/workflows/release.

ons.id-token: write` (configured), Node ≥ 22.14 with npm CLI ≥ 11.5.1 (the workflow uses
Node 24 plu
s `npm install -g npm@latest`), and a `repository.url` that matches this repository.

The Trusted Publisher is configured on npmjs.com for `Steven-Qiang` / `dsh-pwsh-guard` /

l`. A new package has to be published manually once before that configuration exists,
and a new Trus
ted Publisher must complete a successful publish within 2 days or it expires.
